system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: The account temp.jsmith was created on DC-LV-01 by tara.nguyen at 13:41:59 UTC and was added to the Contractors group shortly afterward.
The new account's name and its observed Contractors group membership match the stated temporary-contractor account convention; these facts alone do not establish that the creation was authorized.
tara.nguyen initiated an RDP connection from WS-TNGUYEN-01 to DC-LV-01, and the DC recorded a remote-interactive logon for tara.nguyen from that workstation.
Afterward, tara.nguyen launched GPMC on WS-TNGUYEN-01 at high integrity and that process connected to DC-LV-01 over RPC endpoint mapper, SMB, and LDAP.
tara.nguyen later initiated RDP to FILE-LV-01 from WS-TNGUYEN-01, and FILE-LV-01 recorded a remote-interactive logon for tara.nguyen.

A UserAssist registry value on WS-TNGUYEN-01 contains a ROT13-encoded path that decodes to powershell.exe; this is evidence of a recorded UserAssist entry, not proof of the time or circumstances of execution.

The RDP and GPMC activity from WS-TNGUYEN-01 is inconsistent with the provided practice that remote administration is performed only from WS-KORTEGA-01. This is suspicious, but the records do not establish intent or whether an exception was approved.

known_telemetry_limitations: The provided records show account creation and a Contractors group addition, but do not provide the request or approval associated with the account (S12-00013, S12-00014).
The provided records include a UserAssist entry for PowerShell but no corresponding PowerShell process-creation record, command line, or script contents (S12-00068).
The records establish RDP logons to DC-LV-01 and FILE-LV-01 but do not show what was done inside those remote sessions (S12-00005, S12-00042).
The supplied evidence does not include a complete account-group membership or privilege snapshot, so it cannot establish all effective rights of temp.jsmith.
claims_not_established: Whether temp.jsmith was requested and approved as a legitimate contractor account.
Whether temp.jsmith received any group memberships or effective privileges beyond what is shown in these records.
Whether tara.nguyen's RDP and GPMC activity was approved, or whether it was malicious.
Whether PowerShell actually ran during the review window, and, if so, what commands or scripts it executed.
What actions, if any, tara.nguyen performed during the RDP sessions on DC-LV-01 and FILE-LV-01.
additional_evidence_needed: Obtain the contractor account request, approval, and any related help-desk ticket or change record.
Review complete directory audit records and the current group memberships and effective privileges of temp.jsmith.
Collect DC-LV-01 and FILE-LV-01 RDP session, process-creation, and relevant directory-access telemetry for the sessions identified in S12-00005 and S12-00042.
Collect PowerShell process, script-block, and module logging for WS-TNGUYEN-01 around S12-00068, along with relevant command history if available.
Verify with IT whether tara.nguyen was authorized to access these servers and use GPMC during this interval.
